summary: Tidepool Alpha Free is a stealth model that's free on OpenCode for a limited time; the team is using this time to collect feedback and improve the model. Model ID tidepool-alpha-free, OpenAI-compatible endpoint https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/chat/completions. Free input, output and cached reads. Free-tier chat models require OpenCode. During its free period, collected data is retained and used to improve the model.
